title: A Letter, Unsent
author: unsigned
pages:
Father,

I have kept the shop well and wronged nobody by daylight. I want that written somewhere.
I do not go to the chapel now. The priest looks at each of us a moment too long, and I have seen what happens to the ones he is right about.
The neighbours bolt their sheep in at the full moon and wish me good evening over the fence while they do it. I wish them the same.
If this reaches you, it is because I could not stop one night. Do not come looking.
